mapper.select: select coverage_code, coverage_category_code, coverage_name, duplicate_group_code, description, search_keywords_json, is_active, compensation_type, duplicate_rule_code, recommendation_rule_code, created_at, updated_at from ref_coverage where is_active = true order by coverage_code

select cp.capsule_product_id, cp.capsule_code, cp.product_name, ps.company_name, cp.coverage_category_code, ps.coverage_name, cp.coverage_code, cp.coverage_amount, cp.coverage_unit, cp.monthly_price_male, cp.monthly_price_female, cp.min_retention_days, cp.sale_status, cp.is_duplicate_check_target, cp.terms_uri, cp.terms_version, cp.description, cp.created_at, cp.updated_at from capsule_product cp left join insurance.product_source ps on ps.product_source_id = cp.capsule_product_id where cp.sale_status = 'AVAILABLE' order by cp.capsule_product_id

select cp.capsule_product_id, cp.capsule_code, cp.product_name, ps.company_name, cp.coverage_category_code, ps.coverage_name, cp.coverage_code, cp.coverage_amount, cp.coverage_unit, cp.monthly_price_male, cp.monthly_price_female, cp.min_retention_days, cp.sale_status, cp.is_duplicate_check_target, cp.terms_uri, cp.terms_version, cp.description, cp.created_at, cp.updated_at from capsule_product cp left join insurance.product_source ps on ps.product_source_id = cp.capsule_product_id where cp.capsule_product_id = #{capsuleProductId}

SELECT product_source_id, company_name, product_name, insurer_sector::text as insurer_sector, coverage_category_code::text as coverage_category_code, coverage_code,
round(monthly_premium_male, 0) round(monthly_premium_female, 0) NULL AS monthly_price,
price_index_male price_index_female NULL AS price_index_text, loaded_at, updated_at FROM insurance.product_source ps WHERE 1=1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM public.capsule_product cp WHERE cp.capsule_product_id = ps.product_source_id )
AND coverage_category_code = #{category}::insurance.coverage_category_code
AND (monthly_premium_male IS NOT NULL AND monthly_premium_male > 0)
AND monthly_premium_male <= #{maxPrice}
AND (monthly_premium_female IS NOT NULL AND monthly_premium_female > 0)
AND monthly_premium_female <= #{maxPrice}
ORDER BY product_source_id ASC

SELECT product_source_id, company_name, product_name, insurer_sector::text as insurer_sector, sale_channel, coverage_name, claim_reason, payout_amount, join_amount, minimum_join_premium, payment_cycle, payment_term, coverage_term, coverage_category_code::text as coverage_category_code, coverage_code, CASE WHEN #{gender} = 'M' THEN round(monthly_premium_male, 0) WHEN #{gender} = 'F' THEN round(monthly_premium_female, 0) ELSE 0.00 END as monthly_price, product_summary, product_feature, special_note, contact_phone, sale_date, current_announced_rate, fixed_rate, minimum_guaranteed_rate FROM insurance.product_source WHERE product_source_id = #{productSourceId}
